books.title: Dark Nights of the Soul: A Guide to Finding Your Way Through Life's Ordeals
books.author: Thomas Moore
books.description: Moore sees the hard stretches of life, such as grief, the end of a relationship, illness, ageing or a lingering sense of emptiness, as passages of the soul rather than problems to be fixed quickly. Drawing on myth, religion and the arts, he offers ways to live through these times and find meaning in them.

books.title: Care of the Soul in Medicine: Healing Guidance for Patients, Families, and the People Who Care for Them
books.author: Thomas Moore
books.description: Moore's reflections on bringing soul into modern health care, written for patients, families, doctors and nurses alike. He looks at the emotional and spiritual side of being ill, at keeping dignity and humanity in hospitals, and at how carers can attend to the whole person as well as to the illness.
